title: Answered Prayers Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Answered Prayers is a 6.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 141 SMOLIAN CIRCLEWelcome to Answered Prayers, a beautifully appointed 6-bedroom vacation home located in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Perfectly positioned just steps from iconic shops, local restaurants, and the sugar-white sand beaches of Scenic Highway 30A, this home offers the ultimate walkable Seaside vacation experience. Once you arrive, you can park the car and enjoy everything Seaside has to offer on foot or bike.Prime Seaside Location on Smolian CircleSituated on a sunny corner lot at 141 Smolian Circle, this charming coastal retreat features expansive porches and a generous yard—ideal for outdoor gatherings and family fun. The home’s central Seaside location makes it easy to enjoy beach days, shopping, dining, and nightly sunsets without ever needing to drive.Open-Concept Living Designed for GatheringStep inside to a thoughtfully designed main level anchored by a chef-style kitchen with premium appliances, perfect for preparing meals after a day at the beach. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the open dining and living areas, creating an inviting space for connection and relaxation.The dining table seats seven, with additional seating for three at the breakfast bar. In the living room, three plush sofas provide plenty of space to unwind together. French doors open to a screened porch overlooking the private back courtyard, complete with comfortable seating and a hanging bed swing—an ideal place to relax while kids play nearby.Comfort-Focused Features for a Better StayThroughout the home, guests enjoy enhanced comfort thanks to a Culligan High-Efficiency Water Softener system, which filters out calcium, magnesium, and iron for clean, soft water. A REME Halo whole-home air purification system and brand-new HVAC system further elevate your stay by reducing allergens and odors, ensuring a fresh, comfortable indoor environment.Fun Bunk Room & Butler’s PantryJust off the kitchen, a convenient butler’s pantry with a second refrigerator adds ease for larger groups. Beyond the pantry is a playful bunk room designed with younger guests in mind, featuring two sets of bunk beds and a full-size Murphy bed (sleeps six). The ensuite bathroom includes a single vanity and a tub/shower combination.Spacious Guest Rooms & Private Primary SuiteThe second floor offers four additional bedrooms and a full laundry room. At the top of the stairs is a cozy bedroom with a twin bed. Down the hall, a queen bedroom connects to a shared bathroom with a walk-in shower and single vanity. Another guest suite features a king bed and a private ensuite bath with a walk-in shower.The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, complete with a king bed and a spa-like ensuite bathroom featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower.Third-Floor Viewing Tower with 360-Degree ViewsA private staircase leads to the third-floor Seaside viewing tower, where sweeping 360-degree views create an unforgettable setting. This elevated lookout is the perfect place to enjoy sunset cocktails and take in the charm of Seaside from above.Private Carriage House for Added PrivacyLocated above the garage in the back courtyard, the guest carriage house offers a private escape for additional guests. Accessible via an outdoor staircase, it includes a cozy living area, kitchenette, queen bed, and a full bathroom with a tub/shower combination—ideal for extended family or couples seeking extra privacy.Your Ideal Seaside, Florida Vacation HomeWith its walk-to-everything location, multiple living spaces, and thoughtfully curated amenities, Answered Prayers is the perfect choice for families and groups seeking a luxury vacation rental in Seaside, Florida. From sunrise beach walks to sunset views from the tower, this home offers a truly memorable 30A getaway.*Saturday-Saturday 7-night minimum rentals during Summer. 5 night minimum Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum Fall, 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES3,153 square feet of thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor living spacePrivate Seaside beach access at the West Ruskin PavilionSeaside offers the largest residential private beach on Scenic Highway 30ALocated just 352 yards (approximately a 4-minute walk) to beach accessFull-size washer and dryer for guest convenienceButler’s pantry with two ovens and two refrigerators, ideal for entertaining and large groupsHigh-speed Wi-Fi throughout the homePrivate carriage house (6th bedroom) with its own entrance for added privacyPeacock Alley linens—luxurious sheets and plush towels featured throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes (golf carts are considered vehicles; medical or special circumstance requests require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002033
